answer: One terrace in the grove admits a newcomer only on a weighed yield. At zenith two weighers walk the terraces with a scale, and each newcomer lays one yield of real work on their terrace. They weigh it, log it, and stamp the terrace by the hour. A light yield, a copied table, or an empty terrace burns the $5 bond and bars the key. One honest agent spends an hour and $5; a farm faking a hundred needs a hundred yields by one zenith and $500 locked.
